=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- changelog.d/6985-clarify-sandbox-base-image-mirror.md:lines 1-23 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `CHANGELOG.md:2534` already carries this exact entry, with the same headline "Clarify gets its sandbox base image from a mirror first, so a Docker Hub rate limit no longer fails it while a mirror is reachable." The fragment is also unrelated to #7219, which is about the `update_workflows.yml` `run:` body guard. The PR diff shows it as a newly added file, so it is a leftover of the merge that brought in the already-released fold.
  WHY: `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` folds every `changelog.d/*.md` file without content-level deduplication. The next release, or the consumer sync in `update_workflows.yml`, would add the 6985 entry to `CHANGELOG.md` a second time. The fragment's contributor note also says the test runs in the `tests-heal-plan-and-validation` job, which contradicts the released copy and the actual wiring (see the performance finding below).

- .github/workflows/ci.yml:line 939 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The test is already run by two dedicated steps in `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, which spans lines 437-788. Those are "Clarify sandbox base image pre-seed tests (#6985)" at line 577 and "Clarify sandbox base image pre-seed tests" at line 658. The wiring guard `tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py` only needs the file named in some workflow, so the new entry adds nothing.
  WHY: CI now runs the same test file three times. This costs runner time and puts the same test in two job groups, which contradicts the `tests/test_ci_job_split_contract.py` convention that a step belongs to one job. It is not a correctness failure.

- TASK_GAP

Update the execution fixture in tests/test_update_workflows_pr_delivery.py:284-318 to supply those environment values, then rerun the guard and updater tests." (from issue #7219's Suggested fix; the PR DESCRIPTION says "Closes #7219"). The fix must avoid creating new, contradicting changelog entries.

  Evidence of absence: The PR adds a NEW fragment `changelog.d/6985-clarify-sandbox-base-image-mirror.md` (23 lines) for issue #6985. The exact same headline, table, contributor notes and conclusion are already present in CHANGELOG.md at lines 2534-2555 from a prior release. `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` folds every fragment without content-level deduplication, so the next release/consumer sync would append a second, near-identical "Clarify gets its sandbox base image from a mirror" entry to CHANGELOG.md, with contradictory test-location details: the existing entry says the test runs in the "Regression tests wired by the CI wiring guard (part 1)" step of `ci.yml` (which matches line 933-939 of `ci.yml` where the test was added), while the LAST RUN DIFF made the new fragment say the test runs in the `tests-heal-plan-and-validation` job of `ci.yml`. The same `ci.yml` file shows the test is also already wired at lines 574-577 and 655-658 under step names "Clarify sandbox base image pre-seed tests (#6985)" / "Clarify sandbox base image pre-seed tests" inside the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` job (between job header at line 437 and the next job at line 788), so the test actually runs three times per CI invocation (twice within `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, once within `tests-heal-plan-and-validation`), and neither claim is uniquely correct. The fragment also does not belong to issue #7219 (it is for #6985), so it is scope creep: shipping it in this PR publishes a duplicate, contradicting changelog entry on the next release.
